Every verified milestone exit criterion maps to exactly one evidence-backed completion claim

tasks.title: Load services through a manifest-backed ServiceRegistry
acceptance: Service IDs resolve through an explicit manifest/registry rather than hard-coded Catalog mappings

tasks.title: Drive declarative CRUD, job, and event handlers from service IR
acceptance: GET/list/create/update/delete/job/event handler contracts are represented declaratively
Handler dispatch is generic and does not branch on service or operation names
Input/output/error schemas and effect declarations are validated against IR
Custom handlers require explicit trusted host registration
stop_conditions: Do not allow agent-supplied Python or arbitrary handler code

tasks.title: Generalize Agent Gateway proposals to explicit read/write effects while keeping apply separate
acceptance: Gateway resolves any registered service by service ID
Read and write proposal effects have explicit capability mapping and default-deny policy

Trust-boundary changes require two independent reviews and a new security regression test

tasks.title: Prove a second service can be added without changing core code
acceptance: A second service is added using only manifest, IR, declarative handlers, and policy configuration
No core runtime/Gateway source changes are required for that service

Cross-tenant and unauthorized-write negative tests pass

tasks.title: Inventory and preserve research-only branches and unique evidence artifacts
acceptance: All research-only branches are classified as unique, merged, or snapshot-only with exact commit SHAs
Unique paper notes, workflows, benchmark scripts, and evidence artifacts are preserved on a reviewable branch or in a documented immutable reference
No branch or tag is deleted or rewritten as part of this task
A reachability check proves each retained unique artifact remains retrievable
stop_conditions: No branch deletion, tag deletion, or force push without owner approval

tasks.title: Enforce preregistration and append-only decision integrity
acceptance: Every frozen/ready/historical cohort or decision artifact has a repository-relative path and exact Git blob SHA-1
Any mutation of a frozen manifest, decision register, decision log, or preregistration registry fails CI unless accompanied by a new record/event with previous hashes and rationale
Decision events form a validated SHA-256 chain with unique IDs, ISO timestamps, prior hashes, rationale, affected IDs, and evidence IDs
Dispatched/completed/failed/cancelled/ineligible cohort records require positive run IDs; cancelled and failed outcomes remain visible
Agent factorial cohorts remain no-apply and ready-for-manual-dispatch records cannot already contain run IDs
Negative tests cover changed frozen manifests, changed decision/registry files, duplicate IDs, missing run IDs, bad event chains, invalid statuses, and path traversal
Validator runs in the project-control fast-CI precheck
Factorial cells that are not started due to infrastructure or budget abort remain explicit in the raw cohort artifact with a reason and ineligible classification
Every affected decision ID in an event resolves to a unique decision in DECISIONS.json
Every cohort_manifest is no-apply in both registry metadata and the referenced manifest body, including draft records
Decision event timestamps include an explicit timezone
Run-ledger content is pinned by the latest decision event and every later ledger revision advances the hash chain
CI compares decision-event and run-ledger byte prefixes to the PR base and rejects rewrites or truncation
CI compares the narrative design-decision log, decision-event log, and run ledger byte prefixes to the PR base and rejects rewrites or truncation
E-009 ten-repetition capacity parameters and all acceptance thresholds are stored in a frozen manifest
The manual E-009 workflow consumes that manifest instead of duplicating CLI values and the result records the manifest Git blob SHA-1
The capacity gate evaluates thresholds supplied by the manifest and regression tests prove configuration overrides are honored
The manual E-009 capacity workflow validates the frozen registry and decision chain before starting a run
expected_outputs: Negative regression suite and CI enforcement
stop_conditions: Never rewrite historical run manifests or raw artifacts

tasks.title: Generate scorecards, test counts, and evidence summaries from source artifacts
acceptance: Test counts are parsed from CI logs/artifacts rather than hand-entered
Scorecard claims bind to exact run IDs and source revisions
Failed/canceled/ineligible runs remain visible and are not silently excluded
A CI negative test rejects manual edits to generated metrics without source evidence
The fast runner emits a JSON summary with workflow run ID, attempt, PR-head SHA, checkout SHA, base SHA, per-suite status, output hash, elapsed time, test counts, and skipped counts
Test counts are parsed from unittest output and validated against per-suite records; unknown values are not coerced to zero
The scorecard is deterministically derived from the CI summary, append-only run ledger, and progress register, and pins SHA-256 hashes of all three source artifacts
Scorecard history includes successful, failed, cancelled, and ineligible ledger events without filtering negative outcomes
Every verified completion claim in the scorecard resolves to existing immutable ledger evidence
Negative tests reject manual edits to generated test counts, run IDs, source revisions, and claim evidence without changing the source artifacts
The fast workflow generates and uploads both the raw CI summary and validated machine-readable scorecard, including when a suite fails
Suites without unittest count output retain null/unknown test counts; control-plane negative self-tests are reported as a separate metric
expected_outputs: Negative scorecard provenance and tamper tests
stop_conditions: Do not infer missing metrics or convert unknown values to zero

tasks.title: Run and independently score real-agent proposal/validate/plan cohorts

All failures, timeouts, invalid trials, and ineligible runs remain visible in raw traces
